    depot = instance['depot']
    nodes = {node['id']: node for node in instance['nodes']}
    capacity = instance['vehicle_capacity']
    
    # Collect customer IDs (excluding depot)
    customer_ids = [nid for nid in nodes if nid != depot]
    
    # Precompute distances between all nodes
    def distance(a, b):
        ax, ay = nodes[a]['x'], nodes[a]['y']
        bx, by = nodes[b]['x'], nodes[b]['y']
        return ((ax - bx)**2 + (ay - by)**2)**0.5
    
    # Helper: total demand of a route
    def route_demand(route):
        return sum(nodes[n]['demand'] for n in route)
    
    # Find nearest neighbor customer not yet assigned
    def find_nearest(current, candidates):
        min_dist = float('inf')
        nearest_node = None
        for c in candidates:
            dist = distance(current, c)
            if dist < min_dist:
                min_dist = dist
                nearest_node = c
        return nearest_node
    
    unassigned = set(customer_ids)
    routes = []
    
    # Construct initial routes greedily
    while unassigned:
        current_load = 0
        current_node = depot
        route = []
        candidates = list(unassigned)
        while candidates:
            next_customer = find_nearest(current_node, candidates)
            demand = nodes[next_customer]['demand']
            if current_load + demand <= capacity:
                route.append(next_customer)
                unassigned.remove(next_customer)
                current_node = next_customer
                current_load += demand
                candidates = list(unassigned)
            else:
                break
        routes.append(route)
    
    # Attempt to merge routes if feasible
    merging = True
    while merging:
        merging = False
        new_routes = []
        used = set()
        for i in range(len(routes)):
            if i in used:
                continue
            route_i = routes[i]
            merged_in_this_round = False
            for j in range(i+1, len(routes)):
                if j in used:
                    continue
                route_j = routes[j]

                    new_routes.append(candidate)
                    used.add(i)
                    used.add(j)
                    merging = True
                    merged_in_this_round = True
                    break
            if not merged_in_this_round:
                new_routes.append(route_i)
        routes = new_routes
    
    # Improve routes with local search (2-opt)
    def route_total_distance(route):
        total_dist = 0
        prev = depot
        for n in route:
            total_dist += distance(prev, n)
            prev = n
        return total_dist
    
    def two_opt(route):
        best = route
        best_distance = route_total_distance(best)
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            for i in range(1, len(route) - 1):

                    new_route = route[:i] + route[i:j+1][::-1] + route[j+1:]
                    new_distance = route_total_distance(new_route)
                    if new_distance < best_distance:
                        best = new_route
                        best_distance = new_distance
                        route = new_route
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return best
    
    # Apply local search to each route
    for idx in range(len(routes)):
